This script downloads all basemap grids within the Arctic Boreal Region for a specific year.

# Define Functions
This needs to be updated to just remove the order_id directory within the delivery directory.
```{python}
def rename_data_files(old_path):
    new_path = re.sub(
        "global_quarterly_2025q3_mosaic/",
        "global_quarterly_2025q3_mosaic_",
        re.sub("/[a-z0-9-]{36}/", "/", old_path),
    )

    return new_path
```

# Order Imagery

```{python}
# | code_folding: []
# | scrolled: true

# record time downloads started
start = datetime.now()
print("Downloads started at ", start)

# path for imagery to be delivered to
delivery_directory = "global_quarterly/" + imagery_year + "/q3"

for index, row in grids_filtered.iloc[0:1].iterrows():
    basemap_name = row["basemap_name"]
    item_id = [row["id"]]  # only deliver a single item at a time
    delivery_location = row[
        "delivery_location"
    ]  # delivery_location includes the row number

    # Planet packages orders in a folder with the order ID,
    # I am using the column/row combination as the order name
    # item_id will be saved in the order_log file to check for prior downloads

    # Get prior orders from GCS
    blobs = bucket.list_blobs(prefix=delivery_directory)
    files = [file for file in blobs if re.search("quad.tif", file.name)]
    prior_ids = [re.search("\\d{1,4}-\\d{1,4}", file.name).group() for file in files]

    print("-------------------------------------")
    print(index, ": ", item_id[0])

    if item_id[0] not in prior_ids:  # check if the basemap has already been delivered
        # create the order info
        order_info = {
            "name": item_id[0],
            "source_type": "basemaps",
            "products": [{"mosaic_name": basemap_name, "quad_ids": item_id}],
            "delivery": {
                "google_cloud_storage": {
                    "bucket": bucket_name,
                    "credentials": gcs_key,
                    "path_prefix": delivery_location,
                }
            },
            "tools": [{"file_format": {"format": "COG"}}],
        }

        # Place order
        print(
            "Requesting item for delivery to " + bucket_name + "/" + delivery_location
        )
        request = requests.post(
            "https://api.planet.com/compute/ops/orders/v2",
            auth=(api_key, ""),
            json=order_info,
        )
        print(request.status_code)
        print(request.text)  # raw body as string
        print(request.headers)  # see content-type etc.

        if str(request) == "<Response [202]>":
            print("Order has been placed.")
        else:
            print(request.json())
            if str(request) in ["<Response [400]>", "<Response [401]>"]:
                sys.exit("Invalid request or credentials. Check your request.")
            if str(request) == "<Response [409]>":
                while str(request) == "<Response [409]>":
                    print("Concurrency error. Retrying in 30 seconds...")
                    time.sleep(30)
                    request = requests.post(
                        "https://api.planet.com/compute/ops/orders/v2",
                        auth=(api_key, ""),
                        json=order_info,
                    )
            if str(request) == "<Response [500]>":
                while str(request) == "<Response [500]>":
                    print("Server error. Retrying in 30 seconds...")
                    time.sleep(30)
                    request = requests.post(
                        "https://api.planet.com/compute/ops/orders/v2",
                        auth=(api_key, ""),
                        json=order_info,
                    )

    else:
        print("Item already delivered. Skipping order.")

end = datetime.now()
print("Downloads finished at ", end)
total_time = end - start
print("Dowloading ", len(grids_filtered), " grids took ", total_time)
```

# Rename Files
Rename all files (both data files and manifests) using bucket.copy_blob within a concurrent.futures multithreading process. Then delete all original blobs in one call.

### Copy

```{python}
start = datetime.now()


def copy_blobs(blob, new_name):
    bucket.copy_blob(blob, bucket, new_name)


with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
    executor.map(
        copy_blobs,
        list(renaming_guide.blob)[0 : len(renaming_guide.blob)],
        list(renaming_guide.new_name)[0 : len(renaming_guide.new_name)],
    )

end = datetime.now()
print(f"Copying all old files took {end - start}.")
```

### Delete
~ 2500 files per minute
```{python}
# Check that all files have been copied over
new_names = [
    file.name
    for file in bucket.list_blobs(prefix=delivery_directory)
    if not re.search("/[a-z0-9-]{36}/", file.name)
]

print(len(all_names))
print(len(new_names))

if len(new_names) == len(
    all_names
):  # check that all files have been copied before deleting
    start = datetime.now()
    batch_size = 1000
    batches = [files[i : i + batch_size] for i in range(0, len(files), batch_size)]

    for batch in batches:
        # Delete all old blobs
        with storage_client.batch():
            for blob in batch:
                blob.delete()

    end = datetime.now()
    print(f"Deleting all old files took {end - start}.")
```
